steps.name: collect_spec_snapshot
steps.notes: Capture URL, title/version if visible, change marker, retrieved timestamp, and content hash if available.

steps.name: diff_against_last_review
steps.notes: Only material changes become candidate deltas.

steps.name: update_srs_lineage
steps.notes: Never silently overwrite canonical SRS nodes.

steps.name: payload_regression
steps.notes: Check previously compliant payloads and new fields.

steps.name: promote_or_quarantine
steps.notes: Runtime payment compliance should use approved schema versions only.

risk_levels.low: new optional field with clear semantic family and no conflict
risk_levels.medium: new enum/code value or relaxed constraint
risk_levels.high: new required field, type change, stricter constraint, role change, payment initiation behavior change
risk_levels.critical: security/storage/authentication data policy change or field that affects allow/reject payment decision
